children: Bitcoin is little changed at $61,487.72 in early Asian trade. Concerns including a hawkish Fed, a strong dollar and high real yields for gold, reduced risk appetite, and the Anthropic IPO are limiting Bitcoin bulls' ability to stage a rally toward $70,000, says XM senior market analyst Achilleas Georgolopoulos in a note.(amanda.lee@wsj.com)
